chunks: Saif ibn Umayrah narrated from Abu Bakr al-Hadrami, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
Ibn Abbas used to say: Indeed, the One who counted the sand of Alij surely knows that the inheritance shares do not undergo 'awl from six.

key_terms.رَمْلَ عَالِجٍ: the sands of Alij, invoked as an image of vast quantity known fully by Allah
key_terms.لَا تَعُولُ: do not become increased proportionally in a way that reduces fixed shares
key_terms.مِنْ سِتَّةٍ: from six, referring to the foundational denominator in this inheritance calculation

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about 'awl in inheritance shares?
ai.summary: This hadith cites Ibn Abbas on the question of inheritance shares, affirming that the ordained shares do not become subject to 'awl beyond a basis of six. It reflects a jurisprudential principle in Shia inheritance law and invokes Allah’s perfect knowledge as proof of the precision of the prescribed portions.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5601 - Saif ibn Umayrah narrated from Abu Bakr Al-Hadrami from Abu Abdullah (as) who said:
"Ibn Abbas used to say: Indeed, the One who counted the grains of sand in Alij surely knows that the shares (of inheritance) do not exceed six."
